{{External|rs|rsc}} {{otheruses|the monster called a unicorn}} {{Infobox Monster |name = Unicorn |image = [[File:Unicorn.png|250px]] |release = [[4 January]] [[2001]] |update = Runescape beta is now online! |members = No |combat = 15 |size = 2 |examine = Horse with a horn. |xpbonus = 0 |max hit = 2 |aggressive = No |poisonous = No |attack style = [[Stab]] |attack speed = 4 |respawn = 90 |hitpoints = 19 |att = 11 |str = 13 |def = 13 |mage = 1 |range = 1 |attbns = 0 |strbns = 0 |amagic = 0 |mbns = 0 |arange = 0 |rngbns = 0 |dstab = 0 |dslash = 0 |dcrush = 0 |dmagic = 0 |dlight = 0 |dstandard = 0 |dheavy = 0 |poisonresistance = 0 |venomresistance = 0 |immunecannon = No |immunethrall = No |id = 2837,14043 }} '''Unicorns''' can be commonly found wandering around forested areas. On [[members]] servers, unicorns drop the [[unicorn horn]], which are used in [[Herblore]] to make [[antipoison]]s. They respawn slowly, at a rate of ~53 seconds. Due to the relative length of respawn compared to how quickly they can be killed, it is advisable to farm them in the [[Kourend Woodland]] while [[World switching|world hopping]] in between kills, or to kill [[unicow]]s instead.
